title: NoteNest: Text Editor Core
context: Every editor and notes app needs word counts, find, diffs, autocorrect and bracket matching. Each is a data-structure exercise.
input: Document as a string; paragraph word counts; line lengths.

milestones.title: Autocorrect distance
milestones.requirement: Edit distance between a word and a suggestion.

milestones.title: Words in any paragraphs
milestones.requirement: Prefix sums of per-paragraph word counts.

milestones.title: Find all
milestones.requirement: Count occurrences of a search term (KMP).

milestones.title: Jump to an offset
milestones.requirement: Line containing character offset k: lower bound on cumulative line ends.

milestones.title: Bracket matching
milestones.requirement: Highlight unmatched brackets with a stack.
